messages.author: MYRIAN TORRES RICO
messages.body:
Hi all,
I have checked my files.crd and I realized that, even though I have
very large files.crd of my simulation, I only obtained files.crd with
a few frames...How is this possible? Why does this happen?
Thanks in advance
Myriam

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
You need to provide more details, and at least describe exactly what you did.
On Thu, Dec 31, 2020 at 8:03 AM MYRIAN TORRES RICO
<myriam.torres.iiq.csic.es> wrote:
>
> Hi all,
>
> I have checked my files.crd and I realized that, even though I have
> very large files.crd of my simulation, I only obtained files.crd with
> a few frames...How is this possible? Why does this happen?
How are you checking your files? How are you determining that there is
a problem? For example, a very large system may generate a large
trajectory that only contains a few frames.
-Dan
>
> Thanks in advance
>
> Myriam
>
>
